sentences.en: Shirwadkar's films abound in toilet humour, such as fart jokes.
sentences.zh: 希瑞瓦德卡的电影充满了厕所 humor，比如放屁笑话。

sentences.en: Treasure chests abound in the dungeon, but so do horrible monsters.
sentences.zh: 地牢里宝藏箱很多，但可怕的怪物也很多。

sentences.en: Without dissemination of the facts, conspiracy theories will abound.
sentences.zh: 如果没有传播事实，阴谋论就会泛滥。

senses.zh: 丰富，盛产,非常多，大量存在,充满

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ab（加强）+ound（=und溢出） →溢出→充满
